dataAndPrivacyDifferences.difference: Enabled-account counts and only-one-configured-account explanation are omitted; trace candidates are not configuration inventory.
Retained scalar routing evidence drives native descriptions; incomplete reasons say unavailable in the original explanation location.
Missing measurements and outcomes say unavailable; missing totals use an em dash rather than invented zero.
Stable opaque backend handles and neutral names replace raw account identities; mask only hides these neutral labels. External live quota windows are not read.

Recorded safe provider names and bundled icon/preset metadata retain native precedence; unavailable or unsupported metadata uses neutral/generic fallback. Private group/account identities remain opaque and settings navigation is removed, not stubbed.

Pinned built-in client labels/icons replace installed-client inventory; source-only CSS places the client name beside its icon. Disclosed project basenames appear without session IDs, followed by concrete observed main-session models. Model items move to the next line when necessary and overlong names wrap; full session and selected models remain in the tooltip. Main candidates exclude recorded actors and auxiliary kinds: active distinct models, otherwise latest eligible retained request, never a child-model fallback. Missing eligible evidence omits the model; unknown eligible models stay unknown. Retained main evidence outlives activity linger but not eviction/reset and is independent of replay. Trace has no affirmative main marker; unmarked helpers remain ambiguous. Without project metadata the short-session/unknown-source identity fallback remains. No folder-to-project inference. Full folder metadata is separately opt-in.

Source-local child rows adapt pinned native nested-group spacing/borders (routing.css lines 71-107), with depth-1 indentation, the actual client icon and concrete observed model names only. No visible section/actor label, provider display name, state pill, ID or numbering. Verified requested-provider prefixes use requestedModelName; model namespaces stay intact. Request state/counts and unknown-identity evidence remain in tooltips/accessibility text. Opaque actor keys stay internal; one unknown-actor activity aggregate. No worker ancestry, task completion claim, extra source, wire, or flight endpoint. Child lists are always visible when observed, with no disclosure control; keyboard/touch scroll exposes all retained entries with no added actor cap. No activity wrapper remains when there are no observed children. Only this scoped extension uses plugin CSS; native CSS is byte-identical. New messages translate zh-TW and otherwise fall back to English.
Collected process identity is shown without a gateway URL; missing source clock blocks live playback. Group clock configuration is unavailable.
Recorded quota fields remain; provider-supplied display text, live windows, expiry inventory, currency preferences and exchange rates are not fetched. Native default number/USD formatting remains.
Authenticated bounded whole snapshots replace core polling; collector live status is not process ownership. Hidden/aborted/revoked and generation reset paths clear or pause native playback.
Fixed local images use anonymous CORS so native toneCheck canvas sampling works in the opaque-origin sandbox. Only Origin: null is allowed; no credentials or arbitrary icon URLs.
Original mask and replay retained; group editor links, usage/body actions, context cards and diagnostic-report actions excluded.
